from itertools import combinations

import networkx as nx  # Version 2.3
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # Version 3.0.3
from pybliometrics.scopus import ScopusSearch

# Obtain authors
s = ScopusSearch('SOURCE-ID(21100422153)')
print(len(s.results))  # Number of papers
# 228
authors = [i.author_ids.split(';') for i in s.results]
# Create list of pairwise combinations
combs = [list(combinations(i, 2)) for i in authors]
edges = [i for j in combs for i in j]
# Create network
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)
print(nx.info(G))
# Name:
# Type: Graph
# Number of nodes: 734
# Number of edges: 1636
# Average degree:  4.4578
# Draw and save network
nx.draw(G, node_size=2)
plt.savefig('network.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', figsize=(50, 50))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # Version 3.0.3
import pandas as pd  # Version 0.24.2
import scipy  # Version 1.2.1
import seaborn as sns  # Version 0.9.0
from pybliometrics.scopus import AbstractRetrieval, CitationOverview

# Save yearly citation counts in DataFrame
data = pd.DataFrame()
for eid in ("2-s2.0-84900013243", "2-s2.0-84977703147", "2-s2.0-84977736029"):
    ab = AbstractRetrieval(eid)
    year = ab.coverDate[:4]  # Year from format YYYY-MM-DD
    co = CitationOverview(eid, start=year)
    data = data.append(pd.Series(dict(co.cc), name=ab.title))
# Prepare data for plotting
data = data.T.astype(float)
data.index.name = "year"
data = data.reset_index()
# Plot and save
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 7))
melted = data.melt(id_vars="year", var_name="paper", value_name="citations")
sns.barplot(data=melted, x="year", y="citations", hue="paper", ax=ax)
plt.savefig("citations.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
# KL-similarity of distributions
scipy.stats.ks_2samp(data.iloc[:,0], data.iloc[:,1])
# Ks_2sampResult(statistic=1.0, pvalue=2.922351375337816e-16)

from string import digits, punctuation

import nltk  # Version 3.4.3
import pandas as pd  # Version 0.24.2
from pybliometrics.scopus import ScopusSearch
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer as CV
from sklearn.decomposition import LatentDirichletAllocation as LDA

# Obtain abstracts
s = ScopusSearch('SOURCE-ID(21100422153)')  # Retrieve and cache query results
abstracts = [i.description for i in s.results if i.description]
print(len(abstracts))  # Number of abstracts
# 226
# Stem words
stemmer = nltk.snowball.SnowballStemmer('english')
def tokenize_and_stem(text):
    text = text.translate(str.maketrans({p: "" for p in punctuation + digits + "©atal))
    return [stemmer.stem(t) for t in nltk.word_tokenize(text.lower())]
# Vectorize abstracts
params = {"stop_words": "english", "tokenizer": tokenize_and_stem, "ngram_range": (1, 2),
        "max_df": 0.6}
vectorizer = CV(**params)
matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(abstracts)
terms = vectorizer.get_feature_names()
print(len(terms))  # Number of terms
# 17536
# Perform LDA
lda = LDA(n_components=3).fit(matrix)
# Print ten most important terms per topic
for topic in lda.components_:
    text = ", ".join(terms[i] for i in topic.argsort()[:-10:-1])
    print(text)
